# @alexify/metaskills

> Agent skills for the Alexis JavaScript stack: reusable instructions for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code and Gemini, linked into a project by one command

- Node.js: >=18.0.0
- License: MIT

## Skills

- [alexis-libraries](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/alexis-libraries/SKILL.md) (core): Pick and use @alexify kerberos, wrpc, migronaut, metaschema, protoarray, syncom, mailer. Use when choosing or calling one of them
- [data-structures](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/data-structures/SKILL.md) (library): Custom JS data structures (queues, deques, lists, ring buffers, tries, heaps, graphs, LRU caches, CRDTs, pools). Use when Map, Set or Array are not enough
- [error-handling](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/error-handling/SKILL.md) (core): Classify, wrap, retry and report errors in JS and Node.js, circuit breakers included. Use when code catches, retries or maps failures
- [js-ai-assisted-development](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/js-ai-assisted-development/SKILL.md) (core): Drive LLM coding agents on JS and Node code. Use when writing prompts, specs or rules files, delegating work or reviewing AI-generated diffs
- [js-async-concurrency](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/js-async-concurrency/SKILL.md) (runtime): Bound async concurrency in JS and Node with pools, queues, semaphores, locks. Use for races, lost updates, retries, fan-out or pool exhaustion
- [js-async-patterns](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/js-async-patterns/SKILL.md) (core): Choose and convert async contracts in JS and Node. Use for promises, callbacks, AbortSignal, timeouts, async iterators or unhandled rejections
- [js-contracts-schemas](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/js-contracts-schemas/SKILL.md) (core): Contracts at trust boundaries with one metaschema source for Fastify, Ajv, TypeBox, OpenAPI, MongoDB, wrpc. Use for APIs, validation, DTOs, .d.ts
- [js-conventions](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/js-conventions/SKILL.md) (core): Alexis JS and TS code style for naming, modules, iteration, async, performance. Apply when writing or reviewing .js, .mjs, .cjs, .ts or .d.ts files
- [js-data-structures](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/js-data-structures/SKILL.md) (library): Pick native JS collections (Map, Object, Set, Array, WeakMap, TypedArray) by Big-O and meaning. Use when choosing a built-in collection
- [js-gof](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/js-gof/SKILL.md) (design): Creational and structural GoF patterns in JS and TS (factory, builder, singleton, pool, adapter, decorator, proxy, bridge, facade). Use when implementing one
- [js-local-first-sync](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/js-local-first-sync/SKILL.md) (realtime): Local-first sync with @alexify/syncom, CRDTs, PWA, IndexedDB and OPFS. Use for offline support, merge conflicts or Service Worker bugs
- [js-multiparadigm](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/js-multiparadigm/SKILL.md) (design): Choose and combine JS and TS paradigms (OOP, FP, declarative, metaprogramming). Use when designing modules or picking class vs closure
- [js-solid-grasp](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/js-solid-grasp/SKILL.md) (design): SOLID and GRASP in JS and TS. Use when designing or reviewing modules and contracts, or refactoring god classes
- [metautil-data-structures](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/metautil-data-structures/SKILL.md) (library): metautil ADTs (ConsList, Struct, Queue, Stack, Deque, List, Trie, UnrolledList, CircularBuffer). Use when importing these classes from metautil
- [node-access-control](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-access-control/SKILL.md) (security): Authorization with @alexify/kerberos for roles, ownership, tenants, fields. Use when protecting routes or wrpc procedures or reviewing access
- [node-architecture-styles](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-architecture-styles/SKILL.md) (design): Pick a Node.js architecture (Onion, modular monolith, DDD, CQRS, saga, outbox). Use when designing services or splitting monoliths
- [node-async-context](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-async-context/SKILL.md) (runtime): Request context in Node.js with Fastify request ids, explicit actors and AsyncLocalStorage. Use for correlation, audit fields or lost context
- [node-config](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-config/SKILL.md) (core): 12-factor Node.js config with one validated env schema, secrets and flags, no NODE_ENV. Use when adding a setting or an env var
- [node-crypto-auth](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-crypto-auth/SKILL.md) (security): Password hashing, tokens, sessions, cookies, OAuth and SSO with node:crypto. Use when writing sign-in, storing secrets or reviewing auth code
- [node-data-access](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-data-access/SKILL.md) (backend): The Node.js data layer on native MongoDB. Use for a DAL, repositories, transactions, indexes, migrations or NoSQL injection
- [node-deploy](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-deploy/SKILL.md) (backend): Container images and Fly.io or Vercel deploys for Node.js apps. Use when writing a Dockerfile, fly.toml or a deploy pipeline
- [node-event-loop](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-event-loop/SKILL.md) (runtime): How Node.js runs code, the event loop, libuv pool and timers. Use for callback order, blocked loops, latency spikes, timer leaks or a hung exit
- [node-events](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-events/SKILL.md) (runtime): Write and review event-driven code with EventEmitter, EventTarget and signals. Use for listener leaks, error events or async listeners
- [node-fs-buffers](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-fs-buffers/SKILL.md) (runtime): Node.js files and binary data with fs/promises, atomic writes, safe paths, Buffers and watchers. Use when handling files, bytes or encodings
- [node-graceful-shutdown](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-graceful-shutdown/SKILL.md) (backend): Stops Node.js services cleanly with Fastify, BullMQ, Redis and wrpc. Use for SIGTERM, onClose order, drain deadlines or hangs on deploy
- [node-http-server](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-http-server/SKILL.md) (backend): Fastify and node:http servers with limits, timeouts and undici. Use for routes, plugins, hooks, proxies, hangs, 413s, 502s
- [node-layered-architecture](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-layered-architecture/SKILL.md) (design): Lay out Node.js apps as business modules with Onion + DDD layers on Fastify. Use when adding a module or moving logic out of routes
- [node-modules-packages](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-modules-packages/SKILL.md) (core): Structure Node.js modules, package.json and dependencies. Use for CJS vs ESM, exports, pnpm, ERR_REQUIRE_ESM, cycles or duplicated singletons
- [node-multithreading](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-multithreading/SKILL.md) (runtime): Node.js worker threads, processes, IPC, shared memory and pools. Use when offloading CPU work, adding workers or debugging IPC, races or hangs
- [node-observability](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-observability/SKILL.md) (backend): Traces, metrics and alerts for Node.js with OpenTelemetry and Pino. Use when adding spans, metrics, trace ids or alert rules
- [node-performance-profiling](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-performance-profiling/SKILL.md) (runtime): Measure and profile Node.js with benchmarks, perf_hooks, CPU and heap profiles. Use when code is slow, memory grows or before optimizing
- [node-scaling-highload](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-scaling-highload/SKILL.md) (backend): Node.js scaling with replicas, Redis state, BullMQ, wrpc clusters and load shedding. Use for topology, overload, lost sessions, restarts
- [node-security](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-security/SKILL.md) (security): Node.js security hardening for DoS, injection, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, secrets, supply chain. Use when writing or reviewing servers or outbound calls
- [node-streams](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-streams/SKILL.md) (runtime): Move data through Node.js streams with pipeline and backpressure. Use for large files, uploads, exports, gzip, Web Streams or hanging streams
- [node-tooling-testing](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-tooling-testing/SKILL.md) (core): Set up Node.js quality gates, tests and CI. Use for node:test, c8, tsd, Vitest, Playwright, k6, oxlint, oxfmt, type checks or a Node.js upgrade
- [node-websocket-realtime](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/node-websocket-realtime/SKILL.md) (realtime): WebSocket and realtime on @alexify/wrpc with upgrade auth, rooms, feeds, reconnect, drain. Use for chat, live data, dropped or leaking sockets
- [npm-publish](https://github.com/Alexis-Technologies/metaskills/blob/main/skills/npm-publish/SKILL.md) (library): Prepare an @alexify package release with pnpm, from version bump and CHANGELOG to gates and pack check. Use when preparing a release or publishing
